title: Barely Modified
description: A modpack I believe feels just like vanilla but a little better
body:
Barely Modified aims to enhance vanilla without feeling too modded. The modpack feels like vanilla but just right.This modpack is client side focused and so should be compatible with vanilla servers. (Just be careful with haul)

If you are still debating whether you want this pack, I belive this modpack is perfect for if you just want to play vanilla minecraft; better optimaztion and extra features if you want to use them.

Notable Features:
- Optimazations
- Shaders (via Iris)
- Easy Moving of Chests (via Haul)
- Better Inventory Management (via Mouse Tweaks)
- Easy Rebuilding of Structures (via Litmatica)
